decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to maintain control over the game through consistently disrupting the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence. This is achieved by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive effects like Stifle and Wasteland. Stoneforge Mystic provides access to powerful equipment like Umezawa's Jitte and Kaldra Compleat, boosting the board presence. Delver of Secrets and True-Name Nemesis offer aggressive threats, while cards like Ponder, Brainstorm, and Snapcaster Mage ensure card advantage and consistency. The deck's mana base supports its multicolor spells while also maximizing the effectiveness of Wasteland.

This deck focuses on using disruptive creatures and spells to control the board while applying pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards like Mother of Runes, Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, and Stoneforge Mystic, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while developing its own board presence. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for flexibility in deploying creatures at instant speed, adding another layer of disruption. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying pressure through efficient creatures and powerful equipment.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Teferi, Time Raveler, as well as disruptive cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Force of Will. The deck aims to control the board through removal spells such as Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, while also providing card advantage and selection with Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck is designed to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents by disrupting their game plan and slowly grinding them down.

The focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the necessary cards to generate enough storm count and mana to cast Tendrils of Agony for a lethal amount of damage. Using a combination of Black and Blue spells alongside mana acceleration cards like Dark Ritual and Lion's Eye Diamond, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's hand while setting up for a game-winning combo. The inclusion of Wishclaw Talisman allows for additional tutoring for key combo pieces, while the mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's requirements.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Bomberman combo with Auriok Salvagers and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate infinite mana. This allows for a quick win condition by casting Walking Ballista with an arbitrarily large number of +1/+1 counters. The deck also includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Thought-Knot Seer for disruption and control, while leveraging artifact synergy with cards like Ingenious Smith and Urza's Saga. The inclusion of Gyruda, Doom of Depths as a companion adds an alternate win condition and provides additional value.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through taxing effects like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth while deploying aggressive creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Skyclave Apparition to apply pressure. It also utilizes powerful removal in Swords to Plowshares and Solitude to control the board and protect its own threats. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent with efficient creatures and equipment while disrupting their resources with cards like Rishadan Port and Wasteland, ultimately overwhelming them with a combination of aggression and disruption.

This UWx Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Narset, Parter of Veils to control the game while also keeping the opponent's threats in check with removal spells like Prismatic Ending, Swords to Plowshares, and Supreme Verdict. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect its game plan and disrupt the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Dress Down provide additional flexibility and disruption options, while Shark Typhoon offers a win condition in the late game.

This deck relies on powerful control elements and card advantage to outlast and outplay opponents. By utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Narset, Parter of Veils, along with counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, the deck looks to disrupt opponents' strategies and control the game. Teferi, Time Raveler adds additional disruption while cards like Snapcaster Mage provide flexibility and recursion. The deck also includes win conditions like Shark Typhoon and Timeless Dragon, alongside removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, to maintain board control and secure victory.

The deck revolves around assembling a critical mass of elves to generate mana and draw cards with cards like Glimpse of Nature. The main win condition is to ramp into a Craterhoof Behemoth or Grist, the Hunger Tide, using Natural Order to find them quickly. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Collector Ouphe to slow down the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a large board presence and powerful combo finishers, showcasing the strength and synergy of the elves tribe in Legacy format.

The key strategy of this deck is to use the Elves tribe to generate mana and card advantage, while utilizing various combo pieces such as Glimpse of Nature, Natural Order, and Craterhoof Behemoth to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly. The deck includes powerful cards like Gaea's Cradle and Allosaurus Shepherd to further support the combo strategy. It aims to ramp up quickly, draw into key pieces, and assemble a game-winning board state that can't be easily countered by the opponent.

The deck focuses on assembling the powerful combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Indestructible Marit Lage token in just one turn. The deck includes various tutors and disruption spells to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By efficiently searching for the combo pieces and using protection such as Pithing Needle and Not of This World, the deck aims to win the game quickly and efficiently before the opponent can react or set up their own strategy.

The main focus of the deck is to quickly and aggressively control the tempo of the game by utilizing efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent, while disrupting the opponent with countermagic such as Daze, Force of Will, and Force of Negation. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning for additional removal and direct damage. The deck aims to efficiently control the board while applying pressure and closing out the game as quickly as possible.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and control the game through aggression and efficient spellcasting. Utilizing powerful creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent alongside disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while keeping them off balance. By combining tempo plays with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Pyroblast, the deck can close out games swiftly and decisively. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing the deck to function smoothly and effectively in a fast-paced Legacy format.

This UR Tempo deck aims to maintain constant pressure on the opponent by deploying efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent while disrupting their game plan with countermagic like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also utilizes card selection and advantage through cantrips like Ponder and Brainstorm, along with card advantage engines like Expressive Iteration. With a streamlined mana base and efficient removal in Lightning Bolt, this deck looks to control the pace of the game and come out on top with a mix of aggression and disruption.

The main concept of this UR Tempo Aggro deck is to control the board with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze, while deploying efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler. Murktide Regent provides a powerful finisher, while cards like Brazen Borrower and Lightning Bolt give added flexibility and removal. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo advantage through card selection and mana denial with Wasteland. The overall strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly closing out the game with aggressive creatures and burn spells.

The deck focuses on harnessing the power of enchantments to generate card advantage and ramp into powerful spells. By utilizing a variety of enchantresses and enchantments like Utopia Sprawl and Wild Growth, the deck can draw cards and generate mana at a rapid pace. The addition of Destiny Spinner helps protect against counterspells, while Gloomshrieker can disrupt opponents' plans. The deck also includes a small toolbox of removal and utility enchantments to handle a variety of situations. Overall, the strategy revolves around building a resource engine while controlling the board and setting up for a game-winning combo.
